department: Department of BioSciences (Ecology and Evolutionary Biology)

deadline.value: Apply by December 31, 2026 for full consideration; late applications may be considered.
deadline.quote: Applications submitted by December 31 will receive full consideration

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional and applicants who skip them are not at a disadvantage.
gre_general.quote: Submission of GRE scores is optional for applicants to the EEB program.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Biology subject score is optional but can help.
gre_subject.quote: Scores from the GRE Biology subject exam are optional but can be helpful

supervisor.value: Students are admitted to work with a specific faculty adviser, so applicants should contact potential advisers before applying.
supervisor.quote: All EEB graduate students are admitted to work with an individual faculty advisor or (more rarely) co-advisors. | prospective students should identify and contact potential advisors

funding.value: Doctoral students get a stipend and tuition waiver, continued beyond year one for students in good standing.
funding.quote: Doctoral students who do not hold external fellowships will receive an Ecology & Evolutionary Biology graduate program stipend to cover living expenses. | Support beyond the first year is extended to all students who remain in good standing in the program.

entry_route.value: A BA or BS or equivalent with a strong biology background is the requirement.
entry_route.quote: a BA or BS degree or equivalent that provides a strong background in biology
